jei.robotica.info.servo_core: Dropped by the Scrap Colossus: use a Signal Flare on a Colossus Altar (in Rusted Foundry ruins, or crafted). Opens the Servo Age: the parts and machines that need a Servo Core are built from it. A pricier fallback recipe exists for Peaceful worlds.
jei.robotica.info.magma_core: Dropped by the Forge Tyrant: use an Ignition Charge on a Forge Altar (in Cinder Forge ruins in the Nether, or crafted). A pricier fallback recipe exists for Peaceful worlds. Put it in the Replicator's catalyst slot to copy blazes, endermen, guardians, ghasts and other tier 3 mobs, or in a Survey Rig's core slot to take ancient debris. Blazing Casings use one up; in the Replicator and the Survey Rig it stays.
jei.robotica.info.antigrav_core: Made with a pricey recipe for now. Put it in the Replicator's catalyst slot to copy shulkers, or use it in Null Casings. It opens the Antigrav Age parts.
jei.robotica.info.essence_vial: Right-click a hostile mob to take a sample (2 damage, 3 second cooldown). The first sample binds the vial to that mob type. Eight samples fill it. Put the full vial in a Replicator. Bosses cannot be sampled.
jei.robotica.info.mainspring: A battery you wind by hand. Put it in a Winding Crank and hold right-click with an empty hand to wind it, or feed the crank with FE. It fills in about %s seconds. Mainsprings only charge in the crank, and can then power a robot or machine from its battery slot.
jei.robotica.info.upgrade.speed: Machines work faster and use more FE per action.
jei.robotica.info.upgrade.range: Bigger work area or range: robots +2 radius per card, the Excavator +%s blocks wide, the Wireless Charger +%s blocks.
jei.robotica.info.upgrade.efficiency: Machines use 15% less FE per action per card, never below 40%.
jei.robotica.info.upgrade.fortune: Fortune I to III on mined blocks, more output in the Grinder and Alloy Smelter, Looting in the Replicator. Not with a Silk Touch card.
jei.robotica.info.upgrade.silk: Mined blocks drop themselves. Cannot be combined with a Fortune card.
jei.robotica.info.upgrade.growth: +50% crop and sapling growth per card.
jei.robotica.info.upgrade.void: Deletes junk (cobblestone, dirt, gravel) and outputs that do not fit.
jei.robotica.info.upgrade.height: Architect Table only: every card makes the buildings one block taller, up to %2$s high. Built buildings grow (or shrink) to match.
jei.robotica.info.upgrade.carry: Storage Terminal: right-click the terminal with this card. From then on it keeps every item inside when you pick it up.
jei.robotica.info.upgrade.stackable: Cards of this kind stack in one upgrade slot: each card adds one step, up to %s. The machine says how many it takes.
jei.robotica.info.upgrade.single: Only one card of this kind fits in a machine.
jei.robotica.info.upgrade.rules: Right-click a machine with the card, or put it in an upgrade slot. Machines with a Mk have Mk + 1 slots and take more cards per Mk.
